meta.title: Dragon Ball Super – Stickman Battle Animation
meta.description: Copy-paste JSON template for a 3–5 minute animated stickman Dragon Ball Super battle video. Pure white background, single-line stickman characters, color-coded per fighter, with battle effects, intro, and outro.
meta.author: DBS Animation Studio

how_to_use: 1. Load this JSON into your animation engine (e.g., custom canvas renderer, Rive, or a Node.js canvas script).
3. For each event in a segment, dispatch the event at event.time_sec.
4. Use characters[id] to look up stickman geometry and colors.
5. Use effects_library[id] to render battle effects at the given position.
6. Use animation_poses[id].keyframes to interpolate stickman joint angles.
7. Apply camera presets from camera.presets for zoom/pan.
9. Trigger music_cues at their start_sec timestamps.
